title: 2010 AMC 12B 7
statement: Shelby drives her scooter at a speed of \(30\) miles per hour if it is not raining, and \(20\) miles per hour if it is raining. Today she drove in the sun in the morning and in the rain in the evening, for a total of \(16\) miles in \(40\) minutes. How many minutes did she drive in the rain?

solutions.text:
Let \(t\) be the number of minutes driven in the rain. She covers \(20\cdot\frac{t}{60}\) miles in the rain and \(30\cdot\frac{40-t}{60}\) miles in the sun.

Setting the total to \(16\) gives \[ \frac{20t+30(40-t)}{60}=16, \] so \(1200-10t=960\) and \(t=24.\)

Thus, the correct answer is C.
hints: Let \(t\) be the minutes in the rain; convert each speed to miles per minute
Rain distance \(20\cdot\dfrac{t}{60}\) plus sun distance \(30\cdot\dfrac{40-t}{60}\) equals \(16\)
